name: 92530 · Lake Elsinore, CA
findings: ZIP 92530 (Lake Elsinore) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92530 (Lake Elsinore) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92530 (Lake Elsinore) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
